tasks.label: check
tasks.detail: fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, and the test suite. The pre-commit gate.
tasks.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --workspace

tasks.detail: Debug build against the system SDL3 and ffmpeg.

tasks.detail: What the player runs. Asset decode is unusably slow in a debug build.

tasks.detail: Supply-chain gate: advisories, licences, banned crates, source registries.
